Former UK Minister Admits Using Phone While Driving

Former UK transport minister George Freeman has pleaded guilty to using a mobile phone while driving. A cyclist reportedly caught Freeman looking at his phone, allegedly to check the navigation app Waze, while driving. The incident occurred while he was on his way to a "road safety event".
